summary: Delivery proof and per-field retention mapping for live SIEM connector + on-demand replay capability
description:
Issue summary:
Finova Payments (enterprise customer) has requested a signed delivery proof and a field-level retention mapping for Redwood's live SIEM connector. They need artifacts for a scheduled third-party penetration test and their internal compliance team.

Impact:
Customer cannot complete their pen-test and compliance attestation without a verifiable export and documentation showing field retention and ability to pause/replay deliveries. This blocks their go/no-go for production rollout to a set of regulated tenants.

Request details (what customer asked for):
1) A sample delivery bundle (one hour of prod audit events) delivered via their SFTP endpoint and an accompanying signed manifest (HMAC + RFC3161 timestamp) proving all files were exported and delivered in order.
2) Field-level retention mapping document that lists each audit event field, type, retention default, and whether it is redacted/pseudonymized by default (including examples).
3) Demonstration of ordered delivery and at-least-once semantics for the SIEM connector (replay steps and idempotency guarantees).
4) An on-demand replay runbook and a capability to pause delivery for a single tenant for a defined time window.
5) Evidence of key rotation history used to sign manifests (last 3 rotations) and KMS audit log excerpt showing signing operations.

Acceptance criteria (customer):
- Received signed bundle with manifest and RFC3161 timestamp.
- Field mapping PDF with redaction examples and retention policy statements.
- Console runbook or SRE-validated steps to trigger replay and to pause/resume delivery for a tenant.
- KMS proof showing signing operations for the manifest files.

Attachments from customer:
- Secure link to customer SFTP endpoint details (uploaded to the ticket).
- Pen-test schedule window: 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-19.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer requested sample export for tenant: finova-prod-42 via secure SFTP
Support to stage export: generate 1 hour of audit events from 2026-03-08T09:00:00Z to 2026-03-08T10:00:00Z
Create signed-manifest.json listing files, their checksums, HMAC signature, and RFC3161 timestamp
Push files to customer SFTP and confirm delivery receipts
Provide field-level retention document and replay runbook to customer for validation
logs: No 5xx errors reported. Initial attempt to stage export failed with SFTP permission denied (see comment 1). No evidence of data corruption in local staging. KMS call trace shows signing attempted but returned AccessDenied for the staging key ARN for one rotation entry.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Riley Park: Opened ticket after receiving compliance intake email from Finova. Attached SFTP credentials in secure storage link. Need product + SRE help to produce signed bundle and replay proof.
2026-03-10 | Aisha Gupta: Acknowledged — filing small-workflow to generate export. Assigning to SRE for signing and runbook verification. Tentative ETA 2026-03-12 for initial deliverables.

2026-03-10 | Marcus Bell (SRE): Hit permission denied when attempting to push to customer's SFTP during dry-run. Asking Customer Success to confirm IP allowlist (see FINOVA-SEC slack thread #finova-sftp).

2026-03-11 | Sofia Martinez (Customer Success): Customer updated allowlist to include our egress IP range and provided new SFTP key. Confirmed pen-test window and requested manifest include both HMAC and RFC3161 timestamp.
2026-03-11 | Marcus Bell (SRE): Performed export staging and produced unsigned files. KMS showed AccessDenied for historical rotation operations; escalated to KeyOps (INT-5512 linked).

2026-03-12 | Aisha Gupta: KeyOps confirmed rotation audit visibility gap; they will produce a signed statement and the KMS audit excerpts for the last two rotations. Preparing manifest signing with available key and plan to provide rotation statement separately.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Permission problem when pushing to SFTP was customer-side IP restriction — confirmed by customer update to allowlist.
Hypothesis 2: Missing KMS audit entries for older rotations due to retention window on internal log aggregation — KeyOps is retrieving archived entries from log store (ticket INT-5512).
Export validation: checksums match between staging and pushed files. We observed no gaps in sequence numbers in the audit stream for the hour window selected.

Ordering proof approach: include a sequence-indexed prefix in file names and echo sequence summary in the manifest; also include a small checksum chain (previous-file-hash included) to show linked order

Replay semantics: our current connector supports at-least-once and idempotent writes if destination implements idempotency keys; for SFTP we will provide runbook to resume by filename range and include marker tokens in files to de-duplicate on ingest side (customer to confirm).
resolution_notes: Action 1: Generated one-hour audit bundle for 2026-03-08T09:00:00Z-10:00:00Z. Files pushed to customer SFTP on 2026-03-12 and delivery receipts captured (SFTP server acknowledged files).

Action 2: Produced signed-manifest.json with HMAC (per-tenant secret) and attached an RFC3161 timestamp token from our timestamping authority. Manifest includes file list, per-file SHA256 checksums, sequence index, and previous-file-hash chain for ordering proof.

Action 3: Delivered field-retention-mapping.pdf listing 54 audit fields, examples for redaction and pseudonymization, default retention policy (90 days for PII, 365 days for system events), and configuration pointers for custom tenant overrides.

Action 4: Provided runbook: 'siem-replay-runbook-v1.md' with steps to pause delivery for a tenant, trigger a replay for a given time range, and validate idempotency. Included console screenshots and CLI commands. Stored runbook link in related_confluence_pages.

Action 5: KeyOps provided a signed rotation-statement and KMS audit excerpts for last 2 rotations; older rotation entries are in cold archive and KeyOps will deliver archived proofs by 2026-03-15 (follow-up action).

Follow-up: Create a short product feature request to add an automated 'signed delivery bundle' export in Console (backlog item PROD-1029). Also schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Finova Compliance on 2026-03-16 to validate artifacts.
Status: Initial deliverables sent to customer 2026-03-12. Pending KMS archived rotation entries to close acceptance criteria fully.
